title: Finance integrations and consumer migration
statusReason: Consumer ownership is mapped and the gateway/event/search contract tests pass, but the extracted service implements only a small account/transaction subset with different storage semantics. Route parity and provider-backed behavior are not proven, so no consumer was migrated or prefix cutover enabled.

nextSafeStep: Build an endpoint-by-endpoint contract and ledger-semantics comparison for services/finance, and exercise eligible provider and event paths with controlled integration fixtures before migrating consumers.

followUps.resolution: Resolved as a separate test-only fix in packages/service-runtime/test/capability-gate.test.mjs; the failure was a stale test, not a service-runtime defect. See fin-wp0-evidence.json. FIN-04 status is unchanged (BLOCKED) because route parity is still open.
